gap_details.2014-2015: [phase2] OBSERVED via the UCDMC 'Resident Medical Staff 2014-2015' photo composite (all departments; PDF created 2014-08-22; https://web.archive.org/web/20141220065459/https://www.ucdmc.ucdavis.edu/surgery/education/CompositesResidents2.pdf). Neurological Surgery: Cadena Chief, Liu 6, Lee 6, Ament 5, Keachie 5, Binyamin 3, Bi Mo 2, Goodarzi 1 (no PG4 = no 2011 entrant). The departmental page stayed on the stale 2013-14 list all year.
gap_details.2015-2016: Observed, one reconstructed row: the page omitted every PGY-1; Bart Thaci added as reconstructed PGY-1 (PGY-2 2016-17, alumni grad 2022, 7-yr => 2015 entry). Empty PGY-3 = Bi Mo's class (he left after 2014-15); empty PGY-5 = no 2011 entrant (confirmed by the 2014-15 composite).
gap_details.2011-2012: Observed; no PGY-1 listed and no PGY-2 the next year, consistent with no 2011 entrant (the 2010-11 page also omitted its interns, Ament/Keachie, so an unlisted 2011 intern who left in year 1 cannot be excluded).
gap_details.2012-2013: Nov-2012 capture was the 2011-12 list with Boudreau and Keachie removed (not updated); the May-2013 update is used.
gap_details.2021-2022: Mar-2022 capture used; Oct-2021..Feb-2022 captures listed Anzhela Moskalik under PGY-1, corrected to PGY-2 in Mar 2022.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page (2026-09-27) is advanced from 2025-26 (new PGY-1s Rostomian, Shah) and loaded.
